name: After recital F
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text: Ha. whereas on 1 December 2025, President Trump formally granted a pardon to former Honduran President Juan Orlando Hernández; whereas Hernández had been sentenced to 45 years’ imprisonment following his conviction by a US jury for cocaine trafficking and firearms offences in 2024;
